USER_AGREEMENT.title: User Agreement
sections: About this agreement

These terms govern your use of Surprising EX at https://ex.tokdou.com and its official applications. The operator and contact entity is 河南朔望科技有限公司, registered in China. Contact support@surprising.top for service, privacy or legal questions. These terms describe the software and the rules for any service lawfully made available to you; they are not evidence of a financial licence or permission to offer a particular product.
Eligibility and availability

You must be at least 18 and have full legal capacity. You must not use a service where it is prohibited, where the operator lacks a required authorisation, or where you do not meet local residency, identity, sanctions or suitability requirements. Virtual-asset trading services are not offered to persons in mainland China. A translated interface, a visible market or an accessible website does not establish eligibility. Do not conceal your location or bypass restrictions. A demonstration or test environment must not be treated as a live investment service.
Your account and instructions

Provide accurate information and keep it current. Protect your password, device, verification methods and API keys. Do not share accounts, impersonate another person or permit unauthorised access. Report suspected compromise promptly. You are responsible for instructions you authorise; we will investigate disputed activity using available records. Enabling an API key grants only its stated permissions. Third-party login is optional and does not remove identity or security checks.
Orders, balances and product rules

Before confirming an instruction, check the product, instrument, side, price, quantity, asset, network, precision and fees. Spot, linear and inverse perpetuals, delivery contracts and options have different settlement and risk rules. A submitted instruction is not a promise of execution; an order may be rejected, partially filled, cancelled or remain open. Cancellation is effective only when confirmed, and an already executed trade cannot be cancelled by a later request. The confirmed order and ledger records determine the result, subject to correction of a demonstrated error and applicable law. Read the relevant risk, fees and funds notices before use.
Acceptable use and service restrictions

Do not use the service for fraud, money laundering, sanctions evasion, manipulation, attacks, misuse of another person's data or other unlawful activity. We may request proportionate information, reject instructions, restrict access or preserve relevant records when required by law, security, a substantiated risk or a material breach. Where permitted, we will explain the reason and available review process. Restrictions do not automatically transfer your property to us or cancel rights that mandatory law protects.
Service changes and responsibility

Prices, liquidity, networks and third-party services can change or become unavailable. We do not promise uninterrupted access, a return, deposit insurance or that a loss will be reimbursed by an insurance fund. We will use reasonable care and handle an established service error fairly. Nothing excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded, including applicable consumer rights, fraud, wilful misconduct or other mandatory protections. Your statutory remedies remain available.
Changes, closure and records

Material changes are published as a new dated revision. We retain the revision you acknowledged and request renewed confirmation where required. A new revision does not rewrite an earlier transaction or retrospectively waive a claim. You may request account closure through support, subject to resolving open orders, positions, amounts due and lawful retention requirements. Where lawful and technically possible, remaining eligible assets can be withdrawn after security checks.
Law and disputes

The laws of the People's Republic of China apply, subject to any mandatory law that protects you in your location. Please first contact support@surprising.top with the facts and requested resolution. If a dispute is not resolved, it may be brought before the competent court at the operator's domicile, except where mandatory jurisdiction or consumer rules require another forum. This clause does not authorise a prohibited service or waive a right to complain to a competent authority.

PRIVACY_POLICY.title: Privacy Policy
sections: Who handles your information

河南朔望科技有限公司 is the contact entity for personal information processed through Surprising EX and https://ex.tokdou.com. Write to support@surprising.top with a privacy request. This policy explains the trading product; a separate social product may process different information. Acknowledging this policy records that you received it and is not blanket consent to advertising, unrelated processing or every international transfer.
Information you provide

Depending on the features you choose and their lawful availability, we process account identifiers, email or phone, authentication and verification records, identity-verification submissions, payment details you provide for a transaction, order and account records, support requests, C2C messages and attachments. Do not put unnecessary sensitive information in messages or public content. Identity documents and private transaction attachments are not public announcement media.
Information used to secure and operate the service

The service processes IP addresses, device or session identifiers, user-agent information, sign-in events, security settings, API permissions, transaction and audit records, and diagnostic information needed to detect faults or abuse. Passwords are verified using password hashes. Authentication secrets, private keys and complete identity documents must not be included in ordinary logs. Optional on-device biometric unlocking uses the operating system's authentication result; the application does not receive a fingerprint or face template from that feature.
Optional providers and public media

If you choose Google or Telegram sign-in, we receive the identity and profile fields required by the enabled integration and the proof needed to validate the sign-in. Those providers also process information under their own policies. We use infrastructure and security providers, including Cloudflare R2 and its public CDN for announcement and legal-article media. Loading a public media file reveals network request information to the delivery provider. Private identity and C2C attachments use access-controlled storage and are not published through that public content path.
Purposes and legal grounds

We process information to establish and protect accounts, execute authorised instructions, keep accurate financial records, prevent fraud, meet applicable identity and legal requirements, answer requests, investigate disputes and maintain reliability. The legal basis depends on the activity and applicable law, including performance of a contract, a legal obligation, a permitted legitimate interest or consent where required. Optional consent can be refused or withdrawn without affecting processing already lawfully carried out or information still needed for another lawful purpose. We do not sell personal information as a service feature.
Sharing and international processing

Access is limited to authorised staff and contracted providers that need the information for the stated purpose. We may share necessary information with a transaction counterparty, a provider selected for a feature, professional advisers or a competent authority when legally justified. We do not make identity documents available to other users by default. Hosting, delivery or support arrangements can involve another country. Before a transfer that requires a separate notice, consent or safeguard, the applicable requirements must be met; selecting a language does not consent to a transfer or establish a storage location.
Retention and security

We keep information for as long as necessary for its stated purpose and applicable recordkeeping, financial, security and dispute requirements. Different records have different obligations; closure does not necessarily require immediate deletion of a legally retained ledger or audit entry. We delete or de-identify data when retention is no longer justified, with backups expiring under their retention cycle. We apply access controls, encryption in transit and security monitoring. No network or storage system can be guaranteed completely secure. We will respond to a personal-data incident and provide notices where the law requires.
Your rights and choices

Subject to applicable law and identity verification, you may request access, a copy, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, withdrawal of optional consent or information about an automated decision that significantly affects you. Contact support@surprising.top and describe the request without sending a password, recovery code or private key. We may need limited verification and will explain any lawful limitation or extension. You may also complain to your competent privacy authority. We do not knowingly provide accounts to children under 18.
Devices, cookies and changes

Necessary cookies or secure device storage protect browser sessions, prevent forged requests and remember your language, theme or device preference. Read the Cookie Policy for controls. We do not treat a necessary-session cookie as permission for optional tracking. We publish material policy changes as new revisions and seek a separate choice when a changed purpose legally requires it. The version displayed with your acknowledgement remains available for reference.

COOKIE_POLICY.title: Cookie and Local Storage Policy
sections: Necessary browser storage

Surprising EX uses protected session cookies to restore a browser sign-in and a CSRF token to protect authenticated requests. Session credentials are not ordinary preference data. Device identifiers help recognise sessions and investigate suspicious access. Language, theme and other non-secret preferences may be stored locally. The exact lifetime depends on the cookie or setting and your browser session; a server can revoke a session before its cookie expires.
Your controls

You can sign out, revoke other sessions in account security, remove site data or block cookies through your browser. Removing or blocking necessary cookies may prevent sign-in, session restoration or protected actions. Clearing a local preference resets that preference and does not itself delete an account or its server records. Native applications use platform storage controls rather than browser cookies for every feature.
Optional services

Optional Google or Telegram sign-in can involve that provider's cookies and storage when you choose it. Public media delivery receives normal network request information. This policy does not authorise undisclosed advertising or analytics cookies. If optional tracking is introduced where consent is required, a separate choice must be provided before it is enabled. Read the Privacy Policy or contact support@surprising.top for questions.

TRADING_RISK.title: Trading Risk Disclosure
sections: You can lose the full amount

Virtual assets and related products can change sharply in value, become illiquid or lose all value. A displayed price, chart or past return is not a guarantee or personal investment advice. Only use amounts you can afford to lose and obtain independent advice when needed. Do not borrow to trade without understanding the additional obligations. Eligibility and lawful product availability must be established before a transaction.
Execution and market risks

Market orders can execute at several prices. Limit orders may not execute, and an order can fill while a cancellation is in transit. A stop or take-profit order is not a guaranteed execution price. Thin liquidity, price gaps, market interruptions, reference-price errors and extreme volatility can cause slippage or prevent execution. Check the final order and trade records rather than relying on a button animation or a stale quote.
Asset, technology and counterparty risks

Networks can fail, reorganise or become congested. Smart contracts, token issuers, stablecoins, bridges, custodians and counterparties can fail or be attacked. Assets can depeg or be delisted. Mistakes involving an address, network, memo, precision or security key can be irreversible. Access can be affected by maintenance, connectivity, a device fault or a legal restriction. An insurance fund is limited and is not deposit insurance or a promise to reimburse every loss.
Your decision

Read the User Agreement, Fees, Funds and Withdrawals rules and the specific product disclosure. Monitor orders and account notices, protect credentials and maintain independent transaction records. You remain responsible for the decisions you authorise, subject to the operator's duties and mandatory law. Contact support@surprising.top promptly about a suspected error or compromise.

DERIVATIVES_RISK.title: Derivatives and Leverage Risk Disclosure
sections: Complex products and leverage

Perpetual contracts, delivery contracts and options are complex and may be unavailable or prohibited in your location. They require separate eligibility and an understanding of margin and settlement. Leverage magnifies both gains and losses; a small adverse move can exhaust collateral. You can lose all allocated margin and may owe further amounts to the extent the applicable product rules and law permit. Do not assume a stop order or additional collateral guarantees protection.
Margin, liquidation and price references

Initial and maintenance margin, risk tiers, mark and index prices and collateral eligibility affect the account. Liquidation can occur before a displayed last-trade price reaches your expected threshold. Isolated and cross margin allocate risk differently, and cross margin can affect other positions in that account. The applicable instrument rules determine any liquidation fee, insurance-fund use and auto-deleveraging. Review warnings and maintain sufficient available margin; notification delivery is not guaranteed in time to prevent liquidation.
Funding, settlement and options

Perpetual funding can be paid or received and can change materially. Funding and fees reduce available equity. Linear and inverse contracts use different settlement assets and formulas, so collateral value and conversion risk matter. Delivery contracts have expiry and settlement rules. Options involve premium, time decay, volatility and exercise or settlement risk; selling options can create obligations greater than the premium received. Check the contract size, quantity units, expiry, exercise style and settlement method before trading.
No guaranteed exit

A position may be impossible to close at the desired price during illiquidity, a trading halt, a technical event or a legal restriction. A reduce-only order can be rejected or partially filled according to the current position. Market data may be delayed. Read the market's current specifications and risk disclosures, test your understanding without real funds where a demonstration is available, and do not trade a product you do not understand.

FUNDS_AND_WITHDRAWALS.title: Funds, Deposits and Withdrawals Rules
sections: Check the asset and network

Use only the address, asset, network and memo shown for your current account and the supported deposit route. Check minimums and precision before sending. An unsupported asset, wrong network, missing memo or compromised destination may cause permanent loss. A blockchain transaction usually cannot be reversed. Do not send funds to an address provided in an unsolicited message or to a supposed support agent.
Confirmations and available balances

A transaction broadcast to a network is not necessarily confirmed or credited. Network confirmations, security review, fees and supported-asset rules affect the result. Available, frozen, margin and total balances have different meanings. Open orders, positions, pending withdrawals or legal restrictions can prevent an amount from being transferred or withdrawn. Internal transfers between product accounts do not themselves create a profit or execute a market conversion.
Withdrawal approval and tracking

Before confirmation, review the destination, network, amount, fee, expected received amount and any address protection. Requests may require identity or multi-factor verification, a security delay or a proportionate review. Status changes determine whether a request can still be cancelled; an already broadcast transfer cannot be cancelled by changing the website. Track the request ID and, when available, the transaction hash. Network timing is outside the operator's complete control.
Third parties and claims

A C2C counterparty's payment is separate from an on-chain deposit. Never mark a payment received unless your own account shows the funds, and do not release assets based on a screenshot alone. Use the in-product dispute route for the relevant order. No notice guarantees segregation, custody, insurance or redemption terms beyond a service's actual disclosed legal arrangements. For an error, contact support@surprising.top with the request ID and non-secret transaction details.

FEES.title: Fees and Charges
sections: Before you confirm

The applicable fee schedule and the confirmation shown for the selected product determine the charge. Maker and taker rates, user tiers, rebates, network withdrawal charges, conversions, liquidation and option exercise or settlement fees can differ. This notice does not set a universal rate or promise a rebate. Check the asset, percentage, calculation base, precision, minimum and expected received amount before confirming.
Funding and rounding

Perpetual funding is a periodic transfer determined by the instrument rules and can be paid or received; it is distinct from the trading fee. Rounding and integer asset units affect the final amount. A preview is an estimate when the price, liquidity or network charge can change; the confirmed ledger and disclosed product rules determine the final charge. An unexplained difference can be challenged through support.
Changes and records

Rate changes apply according to the published effective time and applicable notice requirements. They do not silently rewrite a completed transaction. Promotions, referrals and negotiated market-maker terms apply only when their eligibility and conditions are met. Review trade fills, funding records and account ledgers for charges and rebates. Contact support@surprising.top with the transaction reference if a fee appears incorrect.

AML_KYC.title: Identity, Eligibility and Financial Crime Controls
sections: Identity and eligibility

Where lawfully required for an available service, we may verify identity, age, residence, ownership or control of an account and the source or destination of funds. Provide genuine current information and only use accounts and payment methods you are authorised to control. A completed identity check does not establish that every product is available or that the operator holds a particular licence. Product and territorial restrictions continue to apply.
Prohibited conduct

Fraud, stolen funds, money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions evasion, market manipulation, deceptive payment evidence and attempts to bypass verification or location restrictions are prohibited. We may apply risk-based screening and monitoring, request proportionate evidence and restrict or reject a transaction where justified. Information and reports may be provided to a competent authority when required or otherwise legally permitted.
Review and your rights

A review can delay a request. To the extent legally permitted, we will explain what information is needed and provide a route to contest a decision. Some investigative or reporting details cannot be disclosed. A risk flag is not a public finding of guilt. Verification information is handled under the Privacy Policy and access controls; it is not uploaded as public article media. Send questions through the application or support@surprising.top, never by disclosing a password or private key.

COMPLAINTS.title: Complaints and Dispute Resolution
sections: How to contact us

Use the in-product support or dispute entry for the relevant transaction, or email support@surprising.top. Give the account identifier, order or request ID, approximate time, a clear description and the resolution you seek. Attach only relevant non-secret evidence. Never send a password, one-time code, recovery phrase or private key. For suspected compromise, secure your account and report it promptly.
How a complaint is handled

We will record the complaint, verify identity only as necessary, examine the relevant order, ledger, message and security records, and respond through an appropriate channel. We may request further evidence and explain a delay where permitted. A payment screenshot alone is not proof that funds reached a counterparty. Preserve original records and follow the order's dispute process rather than arranging an unrecorded release of assets.
Escalation and legal rights

If you disagree with the response, reply with the reference and reasons and request a further review. You may also approach a competent regulator, privacy authority, court or other body where the law allows. The User Agreement explains applicable law and jurisdiction, subject to mandatory local protections. Contacting support does not automatically suspend a legal time limit, freeze a market position or guarantee compensation. Urgent protective action should not wait for a routine response.

SECURITY_NOTICE.title: Security and Anti-Fraud Notice
sections: Recognise official channels

Use https://ex.tokdou.com and the official application distribution channels. The service contact is support@surprising.top. Check the full domain, certificate warnings and destination before signing in or transferring funds. A similar name, search advertisement, social profile or message is not proof of affiliation. Support will never need your password, one-time code, recovery phrase, private key or remote control of your device.
Protect account access

Use a unique password, enable available multi-factor protection and protect your email and device. Review devices, sessions, API permissions and withdrawal destinations. Grant the smallest API scope required, protect API secrets and revoke unused keys. Local biometric unlocking protects access on that device and does not replace server-side checks or guarantee recovery if the device or account is compromised.
Avoid payment and investment fraud

Do not transfer to a personal address to unlock an account, pay a supposed tax in advance, recover funds or receive a guaranteed return. Do not trust payment screenshots, QR codes or links sent outside the relevant recorded workflow. For C2C, verify payment in your own account and follow the official dispute process. No legitimate announcement promises risk-free profit or makes a private message an approved withdrawal destination.
Report incidents and vulnerabilities

If you suspect compromise, stop authorising instructions, protect your email and device, revoke affected sessions or API keys where possible and contact support promptly. Provide times and non-secret references. Report a vulnerability responsibly through support@surprising.top without accessing another person's data, disrupting service or making unauthorised transactions. This notice is not a promise of a bounty or immunity; coordinate the permitted scope before further testing.
